question_options.question: How would you rate this pack?
What country do you like the most?
Who do you want to see together most?

nodes.text: Howard and Astrid race through the streets of Milan before finding themselves in a small city park!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I... I think we made it...

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Phew... That was quite the run, huh? Nothing like a good chase with the long-armed law to get the heart pumping!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What is `wrong` with you? Do you do this all the time?!
nodes.text_bbcode: What is [color=#e23b3b][i]wrong[/i][/color] with you? Do you do this all the time?!

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Oh, Howard, that man was a total boor! He had no respect for my story!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: No respect?! You threw coffee in his face, Astrid! That's not how normal people act!

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Mmmm... And you know what else normal people don't do? Make kissings in a public park!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: You want to know the truth, Ms. Prez? That's the truth. I like Brendan, and I don't think I can take watching him cuddle with Kat all day!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Prez
nodes.text: Oh, Dinah... I completely understand!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: You do?

nodes.speaker: Ms. Prez
nodes.text: Of course! Look, I know you might think of me as your stuffy teacher... But I'm a woman too! I've gone through all this as well!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: You have?

nodes.speaker: Ms. Prez
nodes.text: Dinah, I spent my entire senior year of college devastated because this guy I liked wouldn't go out with me!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Prez
nodes.text: I moped in my room all day... I wrote terrible poetry... I made ghastly music videos for songs by 'The Kure'...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: I love 'The Kure'!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Prez
nodes.text: Um, okay, but that's not really my point. What I'm saying, Dinah, is that looking back, there's so much more I wish I'd done with that year!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Prez
nodes.text: This is an amazing opportunity to see Europe, a continent just full of rich history, wonderful cities, and handsome, mysterious men!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Prez
nodes.text: Scratch that last one. But honestly, Dinah, do you really want to remember this trip as the time you sat around sadly in your hotel room?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: All right, all right, I'll go to the beach. But when we get back to school, you're showing me those music videos!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: I'm just not a beach person, okay? And I really don't want to be out there on the beach with all those people.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Prez
nodes.text: Oh, Dinah... Are you upset about your body image?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Huh? No, no, that's not what I...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Prez
nodes.text: Don't worry! I did my whole college dissertation on Teenage Body-Awareness And Anxiety! I'm practically an expert!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Yeah, that's nice, but what I'm saying is...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Prez
nodes.text: Ahem, ahem. A lot of girls have unconventional body types, and you shouldn't be insecure just because you don't fit some arbitrary societal ideal...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: No, Ms. Prez, you really don't understand... This isn't about...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Prez
nodes.text: Believe me, Dinah, you're very beautiful in your own unique way! Like a snowflake! A magical, twirling, wonderful snowflake!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Okay, geez, I'll go to the stupid beach! Just spare me this body image talk!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Prez
nodes.text: That's the spirit!
Astrid looks around... And Howard is gone!
Back in the hotel...
Howard comes flying into the room!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Lock the doors... Pull down the blinds... She might still be out there!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Howard! Where the heck were you all night, man? What's going on?!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It's Astrid... That Norwegian girl... I went out with her and... She's totally crazy!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: WHAT?! You went out and hooked up with that hottie? I can't believe it!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Everyone on this trip is getting play except me! Even Brendan is off making out with his new girlfriend! This stinks!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You don't understand, Hector. I didn't make out with her! I barely got away with my life! She's crazy, Hector! Crazy!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Ugh, I just don't get it, man... It's like the girls here are from a whole different culture or something!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah... Tell me about it!
Two days later, in warm, sunny Spain, the group is about to head out for a lovely day on the beach... But not everyone is thrilled about it!
In the girls' room, Dinah sits in the corner, waiting for Brendan and Kat to leave.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: This is horrible... Brendan and Kat will not stop making out!

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: Tee hee! Am I gonna see you in some tiny little swim trunks on the beach?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Yeah, if by 'tiny little swim trunks', you mean 'baggy Hawaiian-print board shorts and a `Superpals` T-shirt that I will take off only for brief intervals'!
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, if by 'tiny little swim trunks', you mean 'baggy Hawaiian-print board shorts and a [color=#e23b3b][i]Superpals[/i][/color] T-shirt that I will take off only for brief intervals'!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Hey, Dinah! You coming with us?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Um... No, I think I'll just stay here!

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: Tee hee! Your loss!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Uh, see you later, I guess...
Kat and Brendan rush out, giggling the whole way.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: And the bleak spiral of my life continues... I finally meet a guy I like, and another girl gets to him first...
Ms. Prez enters the room.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Prez
nodes.text: Oh, Dinah, is Amanda in here? Her father called trying to reach her... Something about a 400-pound teddy bear...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: No, Ms. Prez... She left a little while ago.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Prez
nodes.text: Oh, drat. Would you mind running down to the beach to tell her?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Oh, um, see, I wasn't really planning on going to the beach...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Prez
nodes.text: Well, first of all, it's a required group activity, so you don't get to opt out.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Prez
nodes.text: But more importantly, why on earth would you not want to go to the beach?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Because...

options.label: I don't want to see Brendan.

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: A swim?
Howard looks around and sees a small pond under a bridge.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah, uh... How about over there?

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Oh, Howard, you are the naughtiest little walrus, aren't you? You want to dip some skinnies!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh... Yeah, sure! Why don't you go get in, and I'll join you in a minute... I need to go, uh, take my vitamins.

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: I don't know why a tough guy like you would need vitamins... But I do not care! See you in the water!
Astrid runs and dives into the pond!

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Howard! Are you coming?!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yep! Just one minute!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'll be right there!

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: ...Howard?

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Excuse me?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You know... Just a short little stroll around the park... Maybe through the city... Down to the police station... Nice and romantic!

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Howard, I have been running all across town! I do not want to go on any walks! I want to lie in your muscle-wrapped arms and make kisses all night!

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Now then... Will you show me some of that American cowboy kissing style?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh... Uh... Uh...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Help! Help! I'm being attacked by a crazy lady!

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Excuse me?

nodes.speaker: Italian Man
nodes.text: Hey! What is going on here? Why are you attacking this boy?

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: I'm not attacking anyone, you cretin! We're in love!

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Aren't we, Howard?

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: ...Howard?
Howard and Astrid race away... But Howard can't keep up!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Astrid... You gotta... Go on without me... I'm too... Tired...

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Come on, you wet-headed creme brulee! You run like my great-grandfather... And he's been dead for years!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Too... Tired...
Suddenly, a policeman pops out from around a corner!

nodes.speaker: Policeman
nodes.text: Hey! You two! Stop right there! What are you doing running through the city like a pair of hooligans?
Astrid spins around, pulls a cup of coffee out of her coat and throws it into the policeman's face!

nodes.speaker: Policeman
nodes.text: Aaaaaaiiieeeee!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: No! What?! Why?! How?!

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Run, Howard! He's down! Now is our chance!
Eventually, Howard and Astrid find a safe place to hide in a small city park!

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: We lost them!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Astrid, you can't just act like that! We might be in a lot of trouble!

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Mmmm.... Getting in trouble... How very exciting! I'll need the touch of your firm, manly lips just to calm down!

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: His name was Bjorn, and he had beautiful golden curls, the very color of sunlight...

nodes.speaker: Waiter
nodes.text: Uh, excuse me, madame... But here is your bill...
Astrid furiously throws her credit card at the waiter!

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Just take this, you oaf! I'm in the middle of a story!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey, you don't have to be so mean to him...

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: He interrupted me, mopey muffin. No one interrupts me!

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: As I was saying, Bjorn and I loved like no two souls ever loved... We kissed like two oil-slicked seals performing amateur dental exams!

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: And yet... When I caught him locked in armlock with Ingrid Gaardsaard... Oh, the knives... The knives, they were sharpened!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I knew this girl was crazy... But I didn't realize she was `insane!`
nodes.text_bbcode: I knew this girl was crazy... But I didn't realize she was [color=#e23b3b][i]insane![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Waiter
nodes.text: Um, excuse me, madam... But this card was denied... And I do not think your name is 'Darren Yamaguchi'!

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Hey, Howard, tell me... How good are you at sprinting?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Um...
Astrid spins around and throws her cup of coffee in the waiter's face!

nodes.speaker: Waiter
nodes.text: Aaaaaaiiiiieeee!

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Run!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What... What did you just do?!
Astrid grabs Howard's hand as she races towards the door!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I... I'm so sorry, sir... I'll make it up to you...

nodes.speaker: Waiter
nodes.text: Get them! Get them!

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: 'Just a friend'? What do you mean, 'just a friend'?

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: You mean to tell me that all this passion and sorrow you radiate is nothing more than some unrequited, poopy-dog crush?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I think the term you're looking for is 'puppy dog', actually...

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Who cares what the term is?! I am drawn to the raging tempests writhing behind your eyes... I am drawn to drama!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Now that doesn't surprise me...

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Let me tell you, Howard, a true tale of loss and heartbreak!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Um, okay?

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Ahhh, I knew it. It is the oldest story this world has ever known! One heart promised to another... And yet, how far it does stray!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Well, um... Sort of... Except nothing was really...

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: No, no, Howard, you do not have to explain to me! I know the pain you are feeling, and I know how deep it cuts!

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: I too have loved and lost. I too have been betrayed.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Well, see, that's what I'm saying... Linda and I aren't really...

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: I said, you do not have to explain! I do not need to know about this 'Linda' or her 'long golden tresses' or her 'eyes like sapphires'...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Where are you even getting this?

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Let me tell you, Howard, of my own tale of loss and heartbreak!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: ...Okay?

nodes.speaker: French Man
nodes.text: Well, I... I... Hey, wait a minute, what are you doing here? You said you were at your book club!

nodes.speaker: French Girl
nodes.text: Well I... I... The thing is...

nodes.speaker: French Girl
nodes.text: It does not matter, you scoundrel!

nodes.speaker: French Man
nodes.text: You witch!

nodes.speaker: French Girl
nodes.text: You swine!

nodes.speaker: French Man
nodes.text: You troll!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: I'm just gonna go outside now...
Dinah and the French man slide together onto the dance floor.

nodes.speaker: French Man
nodes.text: So you are American?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Um, yeah. From California, actually. I'm here on a class trip, and I...

nodes.speaker: French Man
nodes.text: Ah, a California girl! How very romantic! Land of dreams and big times!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Um, maybe...?

nodes.speaker: French Girl
nodes.text: Jean-Claude! What are you doing here?! You told me you had to work late!

nodes.speaker: French Man
nodes.text: Marie! My sweet darling girlfriend! I swear there is a perfectly valid explanation!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: ...Girlfriend?

nodes.speaker: French Girl
nodes.text: Oh, there is? You can explain why you are in this club dancing with some teenage American girl?!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Oh, um, I'm sorry, I just... I don't really dance with strangers.

nodes.speaker: French Man
nodes.text: But how can someone ever cease being a stranger unless you dance with them first?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Uh... Conversation?

nodes.speaker: French Man
nodes.text: I was not being literal.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Look, maybe I should just get going... My friends are over there, and I...

nodes.speaker: French Girl
nodes.text: Jean-Claude! What are you doing here?! You leave that poor girl alone!

nodes.speaker: French Man
nodes.text: Marie! My sweet darling girlfriend! I swear, I can explain this!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Girlfriend?! Wow, I'm really glad I didn't say 'yes'!

nodes.speaker: French Girl
nodes.text: Explain? Explain why you are leering at some American teenage girl! You told me you had to work late!

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: Brendan! What are you doing here? I was looking all over for you!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I... I was just talking to Dinah...

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: Yeah, well, `I` want you to be on the dance floor with `me!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, well, [color=#3b78e2][i]I[/i][/color] want you to be on the dance floor with [color=#3b78e2][i]me![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Well I... I don't really like dancing, so I...
Kat grabs Brendan's hand and drags him away.

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: I thought I told you not to talk to her!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: But... But...
A handsome French man walks over to Dinah.

nodes.speaker: French Man
nodes.text: Excuse moi? Madame?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Oh! Uh! Hi!

nodes.speaker: French Man
nodes.text: I just thought you should know that you have a very beautiful face and a wonderful style... You are unlike anything I have ever seen!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: He's really cute... But he looks like he's at least 30!

nodes.speaker: French Man
nodes.text: Would you like to dance?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Well...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Yay! I'll go get the makeup... And the tanning spray... And the hair dye...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Uh, wait a minute, I thought I was just going to borrow some of your clothes...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Are you kidding? That's just the beginning!
A few hours later, in a corner of the hottest club in Paris...
Dinah stands around wearing fake tanner, a skimpy top, a blonde wig, and enormous sunglasses!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: I don't know... Amanda said this looks good, but I feel ridiculous!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Excuse me, miss? Do you know where the restroom is?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Brendan! It's me! Dinah!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Oh! Uh, hi there! You look, uh, different...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Like, in a bad way?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I don't know if I'd go that far... Just, uh, you know, not as, uh, interesting... I mean, uh, well, hmm, yeah, well.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Was that a sentence?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Are you sure?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Yeah... Now that I think about it, it's important for me to be true to myself.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Really? I lie to myself all the time!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: I know, Amanda. I know.
Two hours later, in a corner of the hottest club in Paris...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Everyone here is so pretty and made up... I feel so out of place...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Dinah! There you are! I was looking for you!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: You... You were?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Yeah, I kind of had to get away from the group. To be totally honest, places like this aren't really my thing.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: They aren't?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I mean, look around. Everyone's so fake and artificial, so made up...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: It's nice to see someone else just being themselves!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Aww...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: What's up?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Well... I've never really been to a club before... And, um, I was just kind of wondering, uh, do I look okay? Like, is it okay if I go like this?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Oh, yeah, sure! You look great!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Well, except for the hair. And the white makeup. And the dark lipstick. And that shirt. And those pants.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Oh! Oh! That gives me a great idea!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Huh?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Eating cake in the bathtub!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: No, wait, that's a different great idea... What I meant to say was, we should give you a makeover!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: A... A makeover?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Yeah! Come on! Let's do it!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Um...

nodes.prompt: We should give you a makeover!

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: We should give you a makeover!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Well, that's all I got... If this thing worked, she ought to be totally annoyed with me!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: So, uh, you want to go on a date?

nodes.speaker: Spanish Girl
nodes.text: With a funny man like you? Okay, sure!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Wait, what?

nodes.speaker: Spanish Girl
nodes.text: I like a man with a sense of humor... And a man who is direct about what he wants!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I just... I thought I was being...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Uh, excuse me, Miss... Is this guy bothering you?

nodes.speaker: Spanish Girl
nodes.text: Um, no, actually, we were having a good time...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Look, buddy, just leave the lady alone!

nodes.speaker: Spanish Girl
nodes.text: But I do not want to be left alone! This man has been very charming, you barbarian!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Yeah, well... Wait, what?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hector, I had no idea, man! I don't know how this is happening!

nodes.speaker: Spanish Girl
nodes.text: You know this rude, rude man? Hmph!

nodes.speaker: Spanish Girl
nodes.text: Next time you want a date, leave your obnoxious friend at home!
The Spanish woman turns and storms off.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: What the heck, man?! You try your hardest to fail, and she `still` wants to make out with you? This is ridiculous!
nodes.text_bbcode: What the heck, man?! You try your hardest to fail, and she [color=#e23b3b][i]still[/i][/color] wants to make out with you? This is ridiculous!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hector, I... I don't get it either...

nodes.speaker: Spanish Girl
nodes.text: I... I do not understand. What are you trying to say? Is this a code? Are you a spy?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What? No! I'm trying to hit on you!

nodes.speaker: Spanish Girl
nodes.text: You... You do not dare hit me! My boyfriend is a very large man!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: No, no, not literally hit... It means, you know, to flirt... To want to kiss...

nodes.speaker: Spanish Girl
nodes.text: Oh my gosh... Oh, no, no, I... I don't...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Excuse me, Miss, is this guy bothering you?

nodes.speaker: Spanish Girl
nodes.text: Yes! I think maybe there is something wrong with his brain!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Well, uh, let me just assure you, my brain is perfectly fine... And so are my lips!

nodes.speaker: Spanish Girl
nodes.text: Oh no! Oh my! This must be a beach for crazy people! My grandmother was right!

nodes.speaker: Spanish Girl
nodes.text: Help! Help!
The Spanish woman runs off.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: What... The heck... Was that?! I told you to annoy her, not scare her into buying some mace!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I guess I even failed at failing...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: All right, look. It's not the end of the world. The final stop on our trip is Paris, and I know for a fact we're gonna hit some fancy nightclub.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: If I can't get some action in a club in Paris... I might as well jump off a bridge.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: The way our luck's going, you might want to start looking for a parachute.
And so, two days later, on a cool Paris night... The girls get ready to go out!

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: I'm so excited! Brendan and I are gonna have so much fun!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: You know, they say kissing in France is, like, totally different...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: I think you're getting something mixed up...

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: Ooh! I've got to go see what Brendan's wearing!
Kat rushes off.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: You know, I still don't get how that girl beat you to the punch with that Brando guy. You're, like, fifty times cuter.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Um, thanks, I guess.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Hey, um, Amanda...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Aw, geez, Howard, you're killing me!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Aw, geez, Howard, you're killing me!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: A-ha! Snap!
Meanwhile, at the other end of the beach... Howard is brooding at the edge of the water.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Howard! Buddy! Pal! Wingman!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Look, Hector, I am `really` not in the mood right now...
nodes.text_bbcode: Look, Hector, I am [color=#e23b3b][i]really[/i][/color] not in the mood right now...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I know, I know. You're mad that Linda's with Kenji, and I feel that. I'd be angry too!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: But you know what? They're on the other side of the Atlantic. You're here on this beautiful beach with your old buddy Hector... And he really needs your help!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Let me guess... There's a girl you want to hit on?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Not just any girl, dude! The hottie to end all hotties! Look over there, down by the water!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Okay, yeah, she's really pretty... But the last girl you hit on ended up making me an Italian fugitive! And the one before that got us kicked out of a theater!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I know we haven't had the best track record, but listen! I've figured out the problem!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: See, most Europeans think American tourists are dumb and obnoxious, so they automatically don't take us seriously!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm pretty sure that's just a stereotype... I doubt all Europeans think that...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Semantics! The point is, if we're gonna get girls, we gotta take advantage of that expectation!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: So you're going to try to come off as smart and sensitive?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: No! I'm going to have you walk up to her and be `super` obnoxious, so I look good in comparison!
nodes.text_bbcode: No! I'm going to have you walk up to her and be [color=#e23b3b][i]super[/i][/color] obnoxious, so I look good in comparison!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Okay, fine... But this is the last time!
Howard heads over to where a beautiful Spanish girl is standing.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: All right, all right... I need to be as obnoxious as possible. What's more obnoxious than a pick-up line?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Let's just hope I remember how it goes... If I mess it up, she'll get confused, not annoyed!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Um, excuse me, miss...

nodes.speaker: Spanish Girl
nodes.text: Yes?

options.label: You're big and heavy and full of complicated words.
You were invented by the Chinese.

nodes.text: You know, you're a lot like a dictionary...

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: You know, you're a lot like a dictionary...

nodes.speaker: Waiter
nodes.text: Marvelous! How very bold of you!
A little while later, Amanda and Dinah are seated at the cafe, sharing a plate of a zesty meat in a black sauce.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Hmmm... This tastes pretty good... But it's kind of a unique flavor...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Yeah... I can't tell what it is...

nodes.speaker: Waiter
nodes.text: That, madam, is squid cooked in its own ink.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Oh my gosh! Ink! This is cooked in ink!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Is something wrong?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Yes! Ever since the incident in calligraphy class, the doctors said I couldn't ever eat ink again! How could you do this to me?!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I'm calling my daddy!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Sorry...

nodes.speaker: Waiter
nodes.text: Ah! An excellent choice!
A little while later, Amanda and Dinah are seated at the cafe, sharing a plate of some tasty, crispy biscuits!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: `OMG!` These are `delicious!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]OMG![/i][/color] These are [color=#3b78e2][i]delicious![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: I know, right? They're pretty good!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I am totally ordering these next time I'm at `Taco Dwell`!
nodes.text_bbcode: I am totally ordering these next time I'm at [color=#3b78e2][i]Taco Dwell[/i][/color]!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Well, no, that doesn't...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: You know what? Never mind! These are so tasty, it's probably worth a shot!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Hey, you smiled! I haven't seen you smile in days!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: I guess just going out has helped my mood!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Yay! Now let's go check out some Spanish beach studs!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: It's a plan!
Dinah heads over to a little cafe on the beach, where Amanda is furiously arguing with the waiter!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: What the heck is wrong with you?! Are you deaf or something? I said `I want a burrito!`
nodes.text_bbcode: What the heck is wrong with you?! Are you deaf or something? I said [color=#3b78e2][i]I want a burrito![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: And I am explaining to you, senorita, that we do not serve burritos here!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Uh, Amanda... You do realize where we are, right?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Uh, earth to Dinah? Do I look like some kind of idiot to you?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Of course I know we're in `Mexico!` Why else would people be speaking Spanish? `Hello?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Of course I know we're in [color=#3b78e2][i]Mexico![/i][/color] Why else would people be speaking Spanish? [color=#3b78e2][i]Hello?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Look, Amanda, maybe you should order something else...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Fine! You order for me!
Dinah frantically skims the menu.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Uh... Let's see here... Why don't we get some...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: She doesn't?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: No, she doesn't. She likes you, Howard, really... But the truth is, she also likes Kenji.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I guess... I guess that makes sense...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: So she likes me?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Yes, Howard. She likes you. A lot...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I didn't know! I thought she just thought of me as a friend.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: No, she definitely likes you... But that doesn't mean she'll wait forever.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: How could she not know? We kissed on the Fourth of July! I bailed her out when she stole that float! We've hung out, like, a million times!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Well, yeah, but... Have you `told` her you like her?
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, yeah, but... Have you [color=#3b78e2][i]told[/i][/color] her you like her?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: I'm not saying you should call her up and tell her how you feel... Maybe she's not ready for that, or maybe it's not the time.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: But I know she likes you, Howard. Or at least, she did when we hung out.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: R... Really?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Yeah. Really. But I don't know how long that's going to last, especially if you're too busy being mad that she's with Kenji to even call her up...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: She's not just going to wait forever.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Hey, you two! I don't want to interrupt the lovefest, but there are some cops outside who want a word with you... Something about throwing coffee in a waiter's face...

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Howard! They're onto us! I'll handle it!

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Do not even think about going anywhere!
Astrid shoves past Hector and runs outside!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Now, dude! Now's your chance! Get out of here!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hector, I don't understand! What are you doing?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Man, after everything you've done for me on this trip, the least I can do is help you this one time.

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Hey! There's no police here at all!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Go, man, go! Run! I'll hold her off!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Thanks, Hector! I'll remember this!
Howard rushes into the parking lot... Where Dinah is waiting, gazing up into the night sky.
Play as her, and see if you can turn this night around!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oh, uh, hey.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Hi, Howard. Not enjoying the club, either?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What's the point? The only person I'd want to dance with is back at Centerscore.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Oh! You mean... Linda?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You know I like her?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Well, um... She kind of mentioned it the other day when we hung out...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Did she say anything about me? Did she say if she likes me?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Actually... Linda said she was torn between Howard and Kenji!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Not that it matters anymore... She probably doesn't even want to talk to me.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: What happened? Did you guys have a fight?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah, the other day... I got mad that she was talking to Kenji, and I kind of lost it...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But I mean, it's not fair! I came on this trip to be with her, and then I find out she's back home goofing around with Kenji? How am I supposed to react?!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Howard, the thing you have to understand is...

options.label: Linda doesn't know who she likes.
Linda doesn't know you like her.

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: You will dance?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh, yeah, sure! I'd love to dance with you!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: If I ran, she'd just chase me and throw coffee in my face... If I humor her, I bet I can lose her later!
Howard and Astrid move to the dance floor. She wraps her arms around his waist and nuzzles his chin.

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Ah, Howard... This feels so good, so right... Like we are two pieces of the same hog, split in half at the harvest festival.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Um, yeah, that's a good way to put it...

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Howard... Are you joking with me? Are you only pretending to enjoy this?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: No! No, I'm not pretending at all! Honest!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Must... Keep... Straight... Face!
Howard and Astrid glide together on the dance floor.

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Tell me, Howard... Do you truly feel as I do? Do you love me deeply, truly, purely?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Why, Astrid... I love you like a one-eyed dolphin loves a guiding current, like the moon loves an errant satellite!

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Ooooh, Howard! Your tongue is made of silver!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey, uh, maybe we should go dance by the exit... In case we want to sneak away and make kissings!

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: I love the way you think! So keen... So slippery... So devious...

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Oh, I cannot restrain myself anymore! I must bite into your head!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh...
Howard and Astrid glide together on the dance floor...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Let's see... There's a fire exit over there... And a bathroom I can hide in over there... Maybe if we rotate a little...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: No, no, it just doesn't work! She's too fast!

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Howard! What are you thinking about? And why do you look so distressed?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh, uh, uh, nothing! Nothing at all! I was just thinking about how beautiful you are!

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: You are a poor liar, my treacherous groundhog, and an even poorer dancer!

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: I tire of this! Let us go kiss before my opinion of you has sunk to the very bottoms!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Astrid, wait, you've got to understand, I...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh, the thing is, Astrid, I'd love to dance, but I...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oh my gosh! Look over there!

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: What is it?

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Hey! Get back here!
Astrid whips out of a cup of coffee and throws it into the back of Howard's head!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Aaaaaaaiiiieeeeee!

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: `No one escapes the huntress!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]No one escapes the huntress![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Howard races nimbly through the club, deftly dodging dancers, waiters, and lighting fixtures!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I think I lost her...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Almost there...

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Going somewhere?!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh, uh, uh, well, the funny thing is...

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: No more excuses. No more lies. You have officially made an enemy, my precarious little pumpernickel.
Howard streaks through the club, shoving into one person after another...
Before tripping over a power cable!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Aaaaaah!

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Need some help, clumsy knuckles?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: No! I mean, uh, I'm fine, ha ha, that was a good joke, right? Pretending to run away from you?

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: No more joking, Howard. No more good times gigglefit laughingstocks! I am officially, for serious, `angry!`
nodes.text_bbcode: No more joking, Howard. No more good times gigglefit laughingstocks! I am officially, for serious, [color=#3b78e2][i]angry![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Run towards...
Meanwhile, at the other side of the club...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: This is a total disaster! None of these girls will even give me the time of day!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I dunno, man. Maybe your game just doesn't work over here.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: What is wrong with this stupid continent?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You ever think the problem might not be the continent, Hector? You ever think the problem might be you?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: You know what, Howard? The last thing I need right now is you being a negative Nancy!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I'm outta here.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Wait, Hector, come back! I didn't mean it...
Suddenly, a female hand grasps Howard's shoulder!

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Well, well, well. If it isn't my slippery American otter. It seems you are alone at last.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Astrid! What... What are... You're still... I mean... Hi!

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Did you think you would lose me so easily, Howard? My hunting nose is very keen!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Listen, Astrid, about what happened in Italy... When I, uh, ha ha, you know, sort of ran off...

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Oh, when you left me there, Howard... All alone... In the dark...

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: It made me want to kiss you `so bad!`
nodes.text_bbcode: It made me want to kiss you [color=#3b78e2][i]so bad![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Huh?!

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: A man who runs... A man who can elude me... That is the man I crave the most!

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Dance with me, my writhing lamprey! Dance!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I guess I'll...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: If she expects me to come crawling to her on my hands and knees, she can forget it! I'm my own man!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: No, no, that's not what she wants at all...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Forget it, Dinah. There are plenty of girls out there who'll accept me for who I am. Tell Linda she missed out!
Howard walks right back into the club.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Please! Please! I'll tell you where he went, just stop hitting me!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey! Astrid! You want to get out of here and go somewhere a little more romantic?

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Howard! You are going to go with me... With the willingness?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah. I am. I've wasted enough time pining after someone who's not worth it. I'm through with that.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Now, let's go paint the town red!

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Oh, Howard!
One week later, Linda sits horrified as she watches the evening news...

nodes.speaker: Television
nodes.text: After a tense two-hour standoff, French police report that they have finally arrested the two fugitives.

nodes.speaker: Television
nodes.text: Nicknamed 'The Tourists of Terror', this couple has cut a trail of crime across France, with violations including trespassing, vandalism, theft, public indecency...

nodes.speaker: Television
nodes.text: And fourteen counts of throwing hot coffee in people's faces.

nodes.speaker: Television
nodes.text: While the identity of the Norwegian female remains unknown, the male has been positively identified as an American teenager named Howard.

nodes.speaker: Television
nodes.text: We go live now to the scene of the crime where police are transporting Howard to the local jail. He appears to be screaming something at our reporters...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Well, Linda? Are you happy now? `ARE YOU HAPPY NOW?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, Linda? Are you happy now? [color=#e23b3b][i]ARE YOU HAPPY NOW?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Oh, Howard! How could you?!
There are bad endings... And then there's this! What a disaster!
Give this episode another shot, and see if you can get Howard an ending that doesn't end with him behind bars!

Try again! You can do it!

nodes.text: Howard rushes into his hotel room and dials up Linda.
Ring...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Hello? Howard?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Linda! It's me! I need to talk to you! There's something I have to tell you...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Uh, Howard, before you say anything... There's something I have to tell you... I've just felt so guilty about it the last couple of days...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Huh?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I never had the 'Tasmanian Flu', Howard. I just said I did so I wouldn't have to go on the trip.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But... But why?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Well, because I wanted to spend some time with Kenji... My boyfriend.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Boyfriend?!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: We've been secretly dating for a month... Ever since we stole back that float. I just didn't want you to know because, well, I thought you might get upset...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: No, I'm... I'm not upset...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: You're not? Oh, that is `such` a relief! I was worried you, like, had a crush on me or something.
nodes.text_bbcode: You're not? Oh, that is [color=#3b78e2][i]such[/i][/color] a relief! I was worried you, like, had a crush on me or something.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oh, no, that's, uh, so ridiculous... That's not how I feel at all...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Listen, I've got to go lie down and cry for a couple of hours. I'll talk to you later.
Howard drops the phone and collapses to his knees, sobbing.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Boo hoo... Sob... Boo hoo...
Ouch! There's no way Howard deserves an ending like that!
We know there's a way to make this trip a success... So give it another shot!

args.text: Surviving High School
Try again! You can do it!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah, well, you know what? I'm not going to wait forever, either!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Wait, no, Howard, that's not what I...
You know how France is close to England? Well, you're about that close to a perfect game... Which means you don't get the bonus scene!
Give it another shot and find out what some of other characters get up to on their last night in Paris!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: You know what? Yes, I would!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Oh my gosh! You're totally right! If she likes me... But she also likes Kenji...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Then I can't waste any time fighting with her! I need to call her! Like, right now!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Good luck! Be brave! Seize the moment!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I hope things go well for him... And you know what? Maybe it's time I started following my own advice!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Maybe I need to stop dwelling on everything that's wrong... And start looking at the things that are right!

nodes.speaker: Older Man
nodes.text: Excuse me, miss? Would you happen to know the way to the 'Withered Rose' poetry club?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: No, but I have a map in my...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Oh my gosh! Are you Brobert Smythe of 'The Kure'?!

nodes.speaker: Brobert Smythe
nodes.text: Why, yes. Yes I am. Are you a fan?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Are you kidding me? I love 'The Kure'! You guys are, like, my favorite goth band!

nodes.speaker: Brobert Smythe
nodes.text: I prefer the term 'Angst-and-pain-audio auteurs'... But thank you!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Hmm... According to this map... The club is just a few blocks south of here! Are you going to be performing?

nodes.speaker: Brobert Smythe
nodes.text: Sort of... It's this big open mic poetry night that I'm supposed to kick off with a reading from my autobiography, 'Black Tears On Wet Asphalt'!

nodes.speaker: Brobert Smythe
nodes.text: Would you like to go? I'm sure I could get you backstage...
Back in the hotel room, Howard rushes in... Just as his phone is ringing!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hello?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Howard? Are you there? I've been trying to reach you all day...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Sorry, I left my phone in the hotel room... Listen, Linda, I need to talk to you! I want to tell you that...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: No, Howard, wait. Listen. I need to talk to you first. I just... I want to apologize for what happened the other day.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Huh?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I'm so sorry I didn't call you sooner. I know you were worried about me, and I should've been better at keeping in touch. But I... I... I was afraid.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Afraid?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: The truth is, Howard, I really wanted to go on that trip, but more than that, I wanted to go on the trip `with you.`
nodes.text_bbcode: The truth is, Howard, I really wanted to go on that trip, but more than that, I wanted to go on the trip [color=#3b78e2][i]with you.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: And I didn't call because, well, I guess I couldn't bear the thought that you were off having fun without me.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Linda, if you think I've been having fun without you, you're totally wrong! I've spent this whole time just wishing you were here!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Really?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Really. And I'm sorry I went off on you the other day... I was just so upset we didn't get to have this trip together, I didn't really know what to do.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: It's okay, Howard. I'm not mad at you. In fact... I miss you. A lot.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I miss you, too.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: So we're okay?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: We're better than okay! And trust me, when you hear about some of the stuff that's happened in the last week, you'll probably be glad you couldn't come!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Oh yeah? Got any good stories?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Are you sure you want to hear them? I mean, if you don't want to hear about the trip...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Right now, Howard, there's nothing I want to hear about more.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Okay, so Hector and I were on this beach in Spain...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey, speaking of Hector... I hope he's okay!
Meanwhile, in the girls' room... Amanda is applying a Band-Aid to a small cut on Hector's forehead.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I can't believe that blonde girl attacked you like that! She was insane!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Hey, I'm just glad those bouncers were around to take her away!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Yeah, but I wish they didn't have to shut down the club... I didn't get to make out with any guys this whole trip! What a disaster!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: You didn't get to make out with anyone either? Every girl I've talked to on this trip has turned me down!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: What is wrong with this place?
Hector and Amanda dive forward and start furiously making out!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Smooch smooch smooch...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Oh, Hector!
Well, how about that? Dinah found her confidence, Howard patched things up with Linda, and Hector finally got to make out with someone!
Looks like this Europe trip turned out pretty well after all... Thanks to you!
Way to go, and see you next time on 'Surviving High School'!

args.text: Surviving High School
Thanks for playing! See you in another episode!

nodes.speaker: Howard

nodes.text: Oh man... I need to get out of here!

nodes.text: Uh, yeah, well, kissing is a good time, sure, but, uh, maybe we should, you know, get to know each other first...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Well, uh, that's great, and um, I feel that way too, I guess, in a sense, but you know how it is, maybe we should...

nodes.text: Listen, Astrid, about what happened in Italy... When I, uh, ha ha, you know, sort of ran off...

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Oh, when you left me there, Howard... All alone... In the dark...

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: It made me want to kiss you `so bad!`
nodes.text_bbcode: It made me want to kiss you [color=#3b78e2][i]so bad![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Huh?!

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: A man who runs... A man who can elude me... That is the man I crave the most!

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Dance with me, my writhing lamprey! Dance!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I guess I'll...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You're right! You're absolutely right! I've waited too long... I need to go tell Linda how I really feel!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah, well, you know what? I'm not going to wait forever, either!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Wait, no, Howard, that's not what I...

nodes.title: From Europe With Love
nodes.subtitle: Can you save a trip gone awry?

nodes.text: When we last left off, the Centerscore Trip to Europe had turned into a disaster!
Dinah finally worked up the nerve to ask Brendan out... Only to discover that he was dating Kat!
Meanwhile, Howard, still upset over a fight he had with Linda, found himself trapped in his Milan hotel room with the crazy Norwegian tourist, Astrid!
Can this trip be saved? Will `anyone` have a good time? It's up to you to find out!
nodes.text_bbcode: Can this trip be saved? Will [b]anyone[/b] have a good time? It's up to you to find out!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: How... How did you find me?

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Astrid never loses her prey, my naive little American. You will learn that soon enough.

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Also, you forgot your itinerary at the arcade.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Look, I don't want to be rude... But this is kind of weird...

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Weird? And what would life be if we avoided that which was weird?

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: `IT WOULD BE BORING!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]IT WOULD BE BORING![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Aaaaaaaaah!

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Now then... Shall we go grab some coffee? Perhaps take a lovely stroll?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Well I... I...
Howard glances down at his phone and remembers Linda giggling with Kenji!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You know what? I'd love to go get some coffee with you!

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: There is that angry spirit, the lover who bites! We depart!
And so, a few minutes later, they find themselves seated in a nice Milan cafe.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Weird... This looks just like the pizza place back home!

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Ah, Howard, you know what draws me to you like a moth towards a supernova? It is your darkness, your broken, angry soul. You are consumed by torment!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Well... If you have to know... I am kind of upset about this one girl.

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: And what did this cruel lover do? Make kissings with your closest friend? Reject your lovely, meaningful gift? Insult your family's traditional crafts?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh... Well... Actually...

nodes.text: You're not still mad about the ink thing, are you?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: What ink thing?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Right. Listen, I kind of have a favor to ask you...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: You know what? Yes, I would!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Just as soon as I change out of this ridiculous outfit!
Our extensive testing of this episode revealed that getting a perfect ending was, in fact, impossible.
Fortunately for you, all of our test subjects were mice! Congratulations! You've proved us wrong! That deserves something... A bonus scene, say?
Let's check in with some of our other characters, and see how they're enjoying their last Paris night...
At the 'Withered Rose', the hottest poetry club in Paris...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: 'Ravens swirl around forgotten badgers...'

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: 'Teardrops fall like bitter frost...'

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: 'Under a dark moon, the death bees gather...'

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: 'And we are lost, lost, lost!'

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Wooo! Marvelous!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Marvelous! Bravo!

nodes.speaker: Brobert Smythe
nodes.text: This girl's got talent, eh? That's some grade-A angst!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: I can't believe it... They actually like my poems!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: You know, this really wasn't such a bad trip after all!
Meanwhile, at the Eiffel Tower...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Wow... It's bigger than I imagined!

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: Let's go cuddle underneath it!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Uh, I kind of wanted to go take a closer look... Maybe go on up...

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: Yeah? Well, `I` want to `cuddle!`

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Is that all you ever want to do?

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: Are... Are you unhappy with me?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: What? No! No, not at all!

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: You are! You are unhappy with me! You're gonna dump me! Waaaaaaaaaah!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Man... Relationships are way less fun than I'd hoped!
Okay, okay, so maybe some people aren't having the best time... But then again, some people probably shouldn't have rushed into their relationships!
Will Brendan ever come around? Does Dinah have a shot after all? That's a tale for another episode of 'Surviving High School'!
